Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles taught that we have an “individual responsibility to keep our lamp of testimony burning and to obtain an ample supply of the oil of conversion. This precious oil is acquired one drop at a time—‘line upon line [and] precept upon precept’ (2 Nephi 28:30), patiently and persistently. No shortcut is available; no last-minute flurry of preparation is possible” (“Converted unto the Lord,”Liahona, Nov. 2012, 109).
